notes: v1.7.13 - Remote "feed now" over WiFi now arrives when it says it will. In the every-5-minutes mode the feeder really does check in every 5 minutes (it was checking in every 15 at best), and check-ins are no longer skipped at random, so a queued feed lands instead of expiring. A feed request now expires after 35 minutes instead of 15, and the app tells you when a feed can't be delivered - while Bluetooth is connected, or in after-each-feed mode - and offers to spin the feeder over Bluetooth instead. Remote feeds no longer double up with a scheduled feed, and a skipped scheduled feed no longer blocks a remote one. Re-entering WiFi settings now retries immediately instead of waiting out a backoff. Firmware updates: a completed setup wizard no longer confirms a new build on the spot - the next boot does - so a broken update still rolls back. No settings or schedule changes required.
